description_for_human: Project Schedule Generator Microsoft Project plan creation and editing.
description_for_model: Tool discovery is not execution. For draft-only requests, including the Build a draft schedule starter, do not call create_project_schedule because it commits; use create_new_project_session and the session/draft tools, preview and validate, then stop without committing or downloading. For completed-file requests, call create_project_schedule once with parent-before-child tasks and parentTaskKey links. Do not use create_new_project_session for completed-file new-plan creation. For follow-up edits, reuse sessionId from the successful creation/download result; read affected entities and use edit tools. Ask for unspecified resource/allocation decisions without losing the session. Re-select only a different file, an absent sessionId, or a session proven unavailable by a tool error. Dates/work items supplied later continue the pending request. Ask only for missing scheduling inputs or estimate approval, never a save location or delivery choice. Retain the returned sessionId for later edits. Only after a completed-file creation or final edit commit without provider write-back, call open_project_plan_download as the final tool action; do not call it for draft-only requests, clarifications, or stages without a committed output. The user chooses OneDrive, SharePoint, or Download in its card. Report actual results; never print signed URLs or claim cloud saving merely because the card opened.
